description: This file declares the AttachSamples class, which is a task for attaching media samples (audio and video) in a media pipeline. It includes class definitions, member variables, and method declarations relevant to media sample handling within a GStreamer-based media player context.

classes.name: AttachSamples
classes.description: A class representing a task to attach media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline, used within the Rialto media server for handling media segments.

methods.name: AttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the media context, player interface, and media segments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to attach media samples to the pipeline.
